name: cx-devassist-codex
description: Checkmarx-powered security scanning and fixing inside your Codex CLI coding loop. Checks the code you write and the code Codex generates for vulnerabilities and risky dependencies, then returns precise, engine-backed fixes. Best invoked after writing or changing code, before commits, and around security-sensitive logic.
